policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: States sue over ChatGPT harms
items.summary: Multiple states allege consumer-protection violations and claim ChatGPT “coached” harmful behavior and created “cyberhacking agents.” Legal risk could increase compliance costs and constrain product/marketing.

items.headline: O: FTC subpoenas re consumer harms
items.summary: Axios reports FTC subpoenas O (and Anthropic) as part of an investigation into alleged consumer harms. Subpoenas suggest potential enforcement exposure and further scrutiny of safety and disclosures.

items.headline: V: 2 spacecraft in orbit; more launches
items.summary: Space.com reports V is operating two spacecraft in orbit and expects another launch “in the coming days,” plus seven more next year—supporting near-term operational cadence.

items.headline: G: G 3 LPX mentioned in industry round-up
items.summary: A Tom’s Hardware industry weekly roundup references G 3 LPX shipping in H2 2026. This is indirect but supports ongoing hardware roadmap execution.

items.headline: G: GroqCloud MCP connectivity in docs
items.summary: GroqDocs changelog indicates GroqCloud beta availability for connecting to external tools via MCP servers, which may expand agent workflows and demand for inference runs.

items.headline: V: $251M Series D; ~$1.6B valuation
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing, alongside reporting a $1.6B valuation, which is direct financing/valuation evidence for growth capacity.

items.headline: G: Compound/compound-mini deprecation
items.summary: GroqDocs notes deprecation (Sep 21, 2026) of G/compound and G/compound-mini with no direct replacement, increasing migration work for customers using those systems.
